tasks.gr12-site-situation-settlement-patterns-: Topic: Site, situation and settlement patterns. Cover the meaning of site and situation, nucleated, dispersed and linear rural settlements, access to water and transport, and how relief and resources influence where settlements grow. Ask Grade 12 learners to justify settlement choices using maps and case studies.
tasks.gr12-rural-settlement-challenges-t2: Topic: Rural settlement challenges. Cover rural depopulation, push factors that move people away, ageing rural populations, limited infrastructure, land degradation and strategies to improve livelihoods. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain impacts on people and places or evaluate rural development measures.
tasks.gr12-urban-hierarchy-and-structure-t2: Topic: Urban hierarchy and structure. Cover hamlets, villages, towns, cities and metropolitan areas, the ideas of threshold population and range, central place functions, and urban land-use zones such as the CBD, transition zone and suburbs. Ask Grade 12 learners to classify settlements or explain city structure.
tasks.gr12-urban-issues-and-planning-t2: Topic: Urban issues and planning. Cover rapid urbanisation, informal settlements, unemployment, congestion, pollution, service-delivery backlogs, and how planners use zoning, public transport and GIS data to improve cities. Ask Grade 12 learners to discuss urban problems and evaluate solutions.
